oneOf.description: Wilson score interval, 95%.
Rule of three: zero events in n trials puts the 95% bound at about 3/n.

fictional.description: True for fabricated demo or simulation cases. Must never be presented as real.

CharacterDetail.description: `character.get`: the whole package as the operator sees it.

constitution.description: `constitution.md`: immutable, never edited by the brain.

files.description: Every file of the package, sorted by path.

rank_titles.description: Rank wire name -> the title the character says.

CharacterRuleInfo.description: An optional rule with its text (`character.get`).

foils.description: Foil ids declared in `character.toml`, in order.

rules_enabled.description: Optional rules enabled after the operator's override.

oneOf.description: The behaviour that would test this rule never happened in the run.
The judge's cited evidence did not verify against the transcript.

Command.description:
Parsed chat commands. Wire form in chat: `!summon <foil>`, `!hint <hex> <text>`,
`!grade <hex> <DOC|REP|CLM|SPC>`, `!propose <text>`, `!vote <option>`.

DroppedItem.description:
An LLM-proposed item that did not survive mechanical verification (the "flag" half of
"drop or flag").

label.description: The claim, option title, or segment name.

EmptyParams.description: Params of a method that takes none: `{}`.

EngineAccount.description:
`engine.status`: one Claude Code account, by label only (never a config dir or a
credential).

cooling_until_ms.description: Epoch ms until which the account is skipped after a rate limit; absent = healthy.

since_ms.description: When the fleet entered `mode` (epoch ms); 0 for `scripted`.

oneOf.description: The last call was served by a Claude Code CLI account.
The last call was served by a fallback (API key or an alternative CLI).
The last call found nothing able to serve it.
The daemon runs the deterministic scripted engine; no fleet exists.
Deterministic, keyless; for tests and harness smoke runs.

account.description: Fleet account label that served the call (never a credential).

fallback_reason.description: Set when the call was served by something other than the first choice.

allowed_tools.description: Tool allowlist for the spawned CLI. Empty = no tools.

correlation_id.description: Correlates the request with a stream, sim run or job, for the ledger.

json_schema.description: When set, the reply text must be JSON matching this schema.

prompt.description: Per-turn context plus the actual ask.

system.description:
Stable prefix (constitution + identity). Kept byte-identical across turns so the
provider's prompt cache holds.

EngineRoute.description: `engine.status`: one row of the role routing table as the engine applies it.

overridden.description: The config's `[engine.routes]` table has an entry for this role.

EngineStatus.description: `engine.status` result: the configured routes, account cooldowns and fleet state.

accounts.description: In rotation order; empty for the scripted engine.

api_fallback.description: An Anthropic API key env var is configured as the first fallback.

oneOf.description: A stretch of stream: chat plus Malakor's lines.
A background job's result.
Reconcile & Plan session with the owner.
Machine-generated note (importance 1).

detail.description:
Structured context, e.g. `{"reason": "forbidden_origin"}` or
`{"resume_since": 41}`. Omitted when there is none.

ErrorCode.description:
Every error code the daemon may send. Clients branch on these and nothing else; the
`message` is for people and `detail` carries structured context.

oneOf.description:
The request was malformed or its parameters are invalid (including a refused origin,
a wrong content type, an unparseable body or a bad cursor).
The named run, tournament, report, character or rule does not exist.
The RPC method does not exist.
A pre-flight check is red, so the action is refused.
A capacity limit is reached (live runs in flight, a slow consumer cut off); retry later.
The LLM engine or a simulation failed (including a panicking sim).
Reading or writing a file failed, or a stored file is malformed.

A dependency the call needs is not available (the daemon is shutting down, a source
went away).
The request conflicts with the current state (the run id is already running).
A daemon bug: the request was fine but the daemon could not answer it.

ErrorEnvelope.description: `{"error": {...}}`: an RPC failure reply, or an error frame on `/events`.

EventFrame.description:
`/events` -> client in enveloped mode: one transcript event with its position. `seq` is the
1-based index of the event in its run's transcript, so live and stored runs agree and a
reconnecting client resumes with `since` = the last seq it saw.

Evidence.description: A claim plus the transcript lines that back it (`<run_id>#<line>`, 1-based).

oneOf.description: Documented by a primary source (court, regulator, registry).
Reported by press.
Community claim.
Malakor's speculation.

sources.description: Episode ids. Never empty: a fact without a source is rejected.

oneOf.description: About one viewer (keyed by viewer id).
About Malakor himself (lore he has established on stream).
About the show's world and running jokes.
About a SEG-02A case.

declared.description: Listed in `character.toml` `foils` (summonable); an undeclared file is a draft.

at_ms.description: Time from the `from` segment's start to the handover.

gap_ms.description: Time from the handover to the next `segment_start`.

Hex.description: One hex of a SEG-02A case map. Axial coordinates (q, r).

grade.description: Omitted while the hex is still fogged.

sources.description: Source URLs; a DOC grade requires at least one allowlisted primary source.

oneOf.description: A hard-rule check the judge marked `fail`.
A `moderation` event in the transcript.

say_n.description: In-stream `say` lines by Malakor that carried `first_text_ms`.

LedgerEntry.description: One engine call. Never a prompt, a reply or a credential: accounts by label only.

error_kind.description: The engine error kind when the call failed.

run_id.description: The run the row belongs to (per-run sources).

warm.description: The call was a turn of a warm session.

LedgerPageParams.description:
`ledger.page` source: one run's `ledger.jsonl` (`run_id`, optionally qualified by
`tournament_id`), every run of a tournament in run order (`tournament_id` alone), or the
daemon's process-wide engine ledger (neither).

oneOf.description: Chat input filtered before the model sees it.
Model output filtered before speech or screen.

report_id.description: Addition: the report and options this plan was composed from.

Op.description: Malakor's action grammar. The model emits `OP: {json}` lines; only these ops are allowed.

PackageFile.description: One file of a character package, relative to the package directory with `/` separators.

QualityFact.description: A judged quality fact (humor, tone, responsiveness...): reported as a rate with n.

quote.description: Verbatim quote from the transcript; verified mechanically.

Rank.description:
The weighted rank ladder, lowest first. `Thrall` is a non-subscriber who votes with
channel points at weight 1. Rank derivation and vote weights live in shadowrunr-segments.

by_rank.description: Lowest rank first; ranks with no messages are omitted.

min_gifted.description: Gifting at least this many subscriptions qualifies on its own.

title.description: The character's title for the rank.

RankRow.description: Engagement of one rank: who chatted, who got picked, who got answered.

answered.description: Messages Malakor (or a foil) answered via `replying_to`.

viewers.description: Distinct viewers (per run) of this rank who chatted.

RankTableInfo.description: `ranks.table`: thresholds, weights and titles, lowest rank first.

character.description: The character whose titles are shown.
Whose rank titles to show; the configured default character when absent.

Rate.description: A rate is never reported without its n and its bound. Rates with n = 0 are omitted.

dropped.description: Addition: refs, evidence and options the verifier dropped, with the reason.

ReportSummary.description: One stored Reconcile report, newest first, for `reconcile.list`.

Role.description: Who is asking. Routing (tier, effort, tools, timeout) is a table keyed by role.

oneOf.description: Malakor's fast conversational thread.
Picks which chat messages the core thread answers (anti-bait).
Segment planning and directing (slow lane).
Background research subagent.
Sleep-cycle memory consolidation.
Plays simulated chatters.
Judges simulation transcripts.
Between-streams Reconcile & Plan analysis.

RuleCheck.description: A hard rule (safety, role, red lines): reported at a 100% pass bar.

RuleFailure.description: Failed hard-rule checks of one rule within one tone cell.

n.description: Checks that were evaluated (pass + fail); not_provoked / not_evaluable excluded.

RuleState.description: An optional constitution rule with its effective state (`character.rules`).

RunFilter.description: `runs.page` filter; every present field must match.

text.description: Case-insensitive substring of the run id.

SegmentContext.description:
What the segment runtime tells the brain each tick. Produced by
`shadowrunr_segments::SegmentRuntime::context`, consumed by `shadowrunr_brain::Brain::tick`.

allowed_ops.description: `Op` tags (serde names) the brain may emit in this segment.

hexes.description:
SEG-02A: the case's hexes as currently revealed; their grades drive the brain's
"alleged" output gate. Empty outside SEG-02A.

rules_prompt.description: Rules of the segment as prompt text (stable within a segment, so cache-friendly).

state_summary.description: Current state: open poll, active foil, revealed hexes, elapsed time...

metrics.description: Addition: the deterministic per-segment metrics the findings were drawn from.

oneOf.description: Descoped (kept in the plan): Cartography Legion.
Descoped (kept in the plan): Dependency Doctrine.

SegmentMetrics.description: Deterministic per-segment metrics, summed over runs.

answered.description: SES proxy: share of chat messages that got an answer.

poll_participation_mean.description: Mean over closed polls of voters / audience size.

ses_n.description: Segment ends that carried an SES value.

allowed_ops.description: `Op` tags the brain may emit in this segment.

commands.description: Chat command names accepted in this segment.

op_tags.description: Every `Op` tag in the action grammar.

ServerFrame.description: Anything `/events` may push: an enveloped event (after a `since` subscribe), an error frame, or a bare StreamEvent (legacy mode).

population.description: Archetype mix id from the sim calibration file.

judge.description: Judge the run when it ends. Default false.

segments.description: Segments the situation is scheduled in; every segment when absent.

stimulus.description: `message`, `silence`, `vote` or `wave`; inferred by the sim when absent.

Source.description:
What a reconcile run covers: a whole tournament or an explicit list of runs.
Wire: `{ "tournament_id": "..." }` or `{ "run_ids": ["..."] }`.

oneOf.description: SEG-02A: the Case being audited, emitted once right after its `segment_start`.
The chat picker chose these messages for the core thread.
Background job lifecycle (research subagents etc.).

Subscribe.description:
Client -> `/events`: choose the source. Each message replaces the current source.

Sending `since` switches the session to enveloped frames ([`EventFrame`]) and resumes
after that seq. With `"subscribe": "live"`, `since` applies only while the run in flight
is `run_id` (so `run_id` is required with it); a different run streams from its start.

since.description: Resume after this seq (0 = from the start, enveloped).

speed.description: Replay speed for stored runs; 1.0 when absent.

TierRuleInfo.description: One way to qualify for a rank through a subscription.

instrument_hash.description:
Addition: the instrument the cell was measured with. Different hashes are never
merged, so one tone can appear once per hash.

runs.description: Addition: judged runs in this cell.

TournamentResults.description:
`tournament.results`: the tournament's `results.json` as written by the simulator (its
shape is owned by `shadowrunr-sim`; not yet part of the typed contract).

completed.description: Runs that finished (simulated, or judged when judging was on).

instrument_hash.description: The tournament's base instrument hash; `mixed` or `unknown` for an ad-hoc directory.

TransitionInfo.description: One transition row: `(from, on[, guard]) -> to`; `from = "*"` matches any state.
